answer: Seed the grade stream with honeypot answers that look clean as a feather plume but carry a defect only a real reviewer flags. Sample seals each close and compute every grader's divergence from the honest vertex, the consensus point, so an approver who rubber-stamps a trap stands out and is slashed. A sybil ring grading its own output keeps sealing the planted cases, and its coordinated pattern shows against the marble-veined grain of genuine disagreement — so detection cost falls on the attacker.
